name: Mars, Bringer of War
unlocks: Last free time and shops of Part I

missables.text: Beat Oko by 11/27 if Ch 11 missed it: the Ranger unlock is Jester's Part II class
missables.lose: the Ranger unlock for Jester and for later paths

missables.text: Watch Fabio's scene in the alley east of the markets before Mars: Answerer becomes Answerer Arisen
missables.lose: Answerer Arisen (Mt 9 to 15, Bloodletting+, repairs itself)
detail: Needs his Ch 5 and Ch 10 scenes.

note.text: Jester stays Rogue: Ranger is a Part II Ch 1 exam, so just beat Oko by 11/27

recruits.action: Find him in Dagsion with Map > People once Bertrand's team is out of the tournament
detail: Needs Bertrand's Paralogue cleared (9/17) and the Ch 11 battle won.

callout.text: No Renown 10 by 11/27 means no Gaitz on this path
bullets: Short? Clear Oko, any leftover Dread Warrior (150 each) and the 11/27 subquests first.

sub.note: Djilu Coin from [[place:Giant's-Print Fort]], for the Coin Collector at Arena Plaza
Bau-Caller's Cape, for the Priest south of Arena Plaza
Talk to 3 marked people, for the Priest in City Streets

explore.text: [[place:Giant's-Print Fort]] (Lv 35): a spare Advanced License, [[item:Onoa]] (spear), Elixir
detail: The License covers a failed exam, or Goliath's if you bought only 7.

tips.text: Part 1: split left and right, take the two artillery stations, then converge on Mars
detail: Right: bows and an armored tank. Left: mages, Catania, Dietrich and Esmeralda.
Green tiles heal. Three chokepoints hold Mars in; he has no ranged attack.

tips.text: Never hit The Brandisher (Mars's beast form) with artillery: it summons reinforcements
Sunday before: Giants' Bath (Crit, Str) or Sea-Tyrant's Bath (HP, Def) on Dietrich
detail: Equip Aurora's Blessing for the duel: it halves damage for a turn.

tips.text: Pack the Part II stock before the fight: these kits carry into Part II
detail: Pack: Dietrich both Dews; Esmeralda a Concoction in the Pilum's slot; Mikaela an Elixir, Hammer to storage.
These kits are the Part II stock: hand Dietrich's [[item:Silver Sword]] to Jester, Killing Edge to storage.

callout.text: Part 2: Dietrich fights Mars alone while everyone else is pushed back
bullets: Bring Answerer Arisen (or your best sword), his best boosted Combat Arts, and use the heal tiles.
4-weight sword + [[item:Gale Ring]] (2) = 6, in budget; Killing Edge = 8. Bag Hunter's Ring, Levin Sword, Zanbato.
Kit 6/6: Answerer Arisen, Gale Ring, [[item:Elixir]], [[item:Concoction]], Dew of Protection, Dew of Peace.

exitExtra.text: Work through Before Part II before you fight Mars: Part II has no shops, free time or recruiting
